title: Base Context & Transit Infrastructure
subtitle: Bandon Built-Up Areas (BUA) and Network Baseline
question: What geographic and transport-network context frames the Bandon analysis?
key_takeaway: Built-up areas and the network baseline establish the geographic frame for the subsequent evidence.

title: Physical Pedestrian Catchments
subtitle: Network-Based Isochronal Walkability Analysis
question: How far can people walk through the pedestrian network to reach transit?
key_takeaway: Network-based catchments describe pedestrian reach using travel-time thresholds.

title: Pedestrian Network Context
subtitle: Footpath Coverage and Pedestrian Crossing Networks
question: What pedestrian infrastructure supports or constrains access?
key_takeaway: Footpath and crossing coverage provides context for interpreting network-based walking access.

title: Headway & Operational Frequency
subtitle: Peak-Period Transit Service Quality
question: How does scheduled service availability vary across the study area?
key_takeaway: Peak-period frequency and headway describe the scheduled transit service available at stops.

title: Demographic Vulnerability & Demand
subtitle: Spatial Distribution of Relative Population Vulnerability
question: Where are relative population vulnerability and potential transport needs concentrated?
key_takeaway: Census-based indicators describe the spatial distribution of relative population vulnerability.

title: Composite Accessibility Index (CAI)
subtitle: Combined Pedestrian Accessibility and Scheduled Service Availability
question: How do pedestrian access and scheduled service combine?
key_takeaway: The CAI combines pedestrian accessibility and scheduled service availability into a composite measure.

title: Targeted Intervention Framework
subtitle: Spatial Screening Priorities for Further Investigation
question: Where do relative access deficit and population vulnerability overlap?
key_takeaway: The screening identifies locations for further investigation where accessibility and vulnerability evidence overlap.
